````markdown
# M9.2 — `/save-log` skill: plan

## Context

`docs/meeting-notes/2026-05-26-r1.md` proposes turning Claude Code background-session transcripts into clean, reviewable Markdown via `claude-code-log` (uvx), exposed as a project skill at `.claude/skills/save-log/SKILL.md` and a backing Python script `scripts/save_claude_session_log.py`. The motivation: `claude logs <session-id>` only emits terminal output with ANSI cursor/control sequences; clean Markdown must come from the transcript JSONL under `~/.claude/projects/`. The end-state is a `/save-log <name|id>` slash command that drops `docs/logs/<session-name>.md` ready for handoff packs.

This complements the M9.1 (session-memory hardening) plan, which is still planning-only. M9.2 is a focused, executable tooling milestone — small surface, no schema changes, no Kaggle/network side effects, just a local skill + script.

## Scope

Land a working `/save-log <name|id>` skill that exports a **stopped or completed** Claude Code background session transcript to `docs/logs/<session-name>.md`, with:

- transcript-JSONL source (no ANSI terminal scraping);
- selector matching by agent name, short job id, or session id (longest-prefix / exact-match scoring; ambiguous fuzzy matches fail loudly);
- terminal-state gate (`completed`/`stopped` only, unless `--allow-any-state`);
- secret-pattern scan that refuses to write unless `--allow-secret-like`;
- atomic overwrite (write `.tmp.md` → `replace`);
- structured JSON closeout printed to stdout for the skill caller.

Milestone numbering: insert **M9.2** between M9 (done) and M10 (in planning). M10–M13 numbering stays.

## Non-goals

- No new schema / migrations / Supabase rows.
- No Kaggle, GitHub, or other external network call.
- No automatic commit of `docs/logs/*.md` (humans review and commit by hand). `docs/logs/` is **not** gitignored — exports are repo-eligible after human review.
- No fallback to `claude logs` terminal output. If the transcript JSONL can't be located, fail loudly with the exact `find` hint from the meeting notes.
- No `.claude/commands/save-log.md` — skill-only per meeting notes (skills override commands of the same name).
- No model-invoked autorun: the skill sets `disable-model-invocation: true` so only the human types `/save-log`.

## Files to create

```
.claude/skills/save-log/SKILL.md          (new — frontmatter + body)
scripts/save_claude_session_log.py        (new — the implementation from meeting notes §3)
docs/logs/.gitkeep                        (new — keeps the dir tracked even when empty)
docs/m9_2-loop-prompts.md                 (new — 3 Loop Prompts, M10-style)
docs/tasks/M9_2-T000-save-log-scaffold-and-impl.md
docs/tasks/M9_2-T001-save-log-smoke-and-docs.md
docs/tasks/M9_2-T002-m9_2-exit-criteria.md
```

## Files to update

```
docs/milestones.md          (add §M9.2 between §M9 and §M10)
PROJECT_STATE.md            (set current milestone to M9.2; brief description)
README.md                   (update current-milestone block to point at M9.2)
```

## Implementation reference

The Python script body and SKILL.md content come straight from `docs/meeting-notes/2026-05-26-r1.md` §2–3 (lines 134–666). Treat that as the canonical spec; the only edits are:

1. Honour the dev-phase secret carve-out in `CLAUDE.md` and the `[[feedback_permissive_github_dev_phase]]` memory: the script does **not** read `.env`, `~/.kaggle/kaggle.json`, `~/.ssh`, `~/.aws`, or `~/.config/gcloud`. It only reads `~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl` and `~/.claude/jobs/*/state.json` plus `claude agents --json` output.
2. `claude_config_dir()` already respects `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`; verify it resolves to `~/.claude` in this repo (the auto-memory directory under `~/.claude-ayla` is unrelated — that's harness state, not Claude Code transcripts).
3. `project_root()` should fall through to `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`, then `Path.cwd()`. Output path lives at `<root>/docs/logs/<safe-name>.md`.

Critical existing utilities to lean on rather than reinvent:

- `subprocess.run` for `claude agents --json` and `uvx claude-code-log@latest …` (no new helper layer).
- `re` for secret-pattern scan — list of nine patterns specified in meeting notes §3 (`SECRET_PATTERNS`). Keep that list verbatim; do not invent new ones.
- `pathlib.Path` and `tempfile.TemporaryDirectory` for atomic write.

## SKILL.md frontmatter

Mirror existing skill frontmatter conventions visible in `.claude/skills/worktree-milestone-pr/SKILL.md` (`name:` + `description:` only) **plus** the extra fields the meeting notes call for:

```yaml
---
name: save-log
description: Export a stopped or completed Claude Code background session transcript to docs/logs/<session-name>.md using claude-code-log.
argument-hint: "<name|id>"
arguments:
  - session
allowed-tools:
  - Bash(python scripts/save_claude_session_log.py*)
disable-model-invocation: true
tags:
  - logging
  - handoff
  - claude-code
---
```

If Claude Code's skill loader rejects any of `argument-hint`, `arguments`, `allowed-tools`, `disable-model-invocation`, or `tags` (i.e. they aren't honoured by the current loader), drop the unknown keys and keep `name:` + `description:`; the meeting notes are advisory on those fields.

## Loop Prompts (in `docs/m9_2-loop-prompts.md`)

Each Loop Prompt follows `docs/milestone-loop-protocol.md` and runs inside its own worktree (default per [[feedback_direct_edits]] + protocol §5). M10's `docs/m10-loop-prompts.md` is the structural template.

- **Loop Prompt 0 — M9.2-T000: scaffold + implementation.** Create the skill, script, `docs/logs/.gitkeep`. Implement the script per meeting-notes §3. Run `ruff check scripts/save_claude_session_log.py` and `python scripts/save_claude_session_log.py --help` to confirm it parses. Verify `uvx --version` and `uvx claude-code-log@latest --help` are reachable in the dev environment (record the version). No real export yet.
- **Loop Prompt 1 — M9.2-T001: smoke + docs.** Find an actual stopped/completed background session (the M9 / M10 closeout jobs likely qualify) and run `/save-log <name|id>` end-to-end. Confirm `docs/logs/<name>.md` is written, the header block is present, and the secret scanner did not trip on the real transcript. Negative tests: (a) a running session → refusal with clear message; (b) an ambiguous fuzzy selector → refusal with candidate list; (c) a synthetic transcript containing `sk-ant-…` → refusal unless `--allow-secret-like`. Update `README.md` briefly to mention `/save-log`. Confirm `docs/logs/` is **not** gitignored.
- **Loop Prompt 2 — M9.2-T002: exit criteria + final review.** Write `docs/m9_2-final-review.md` via the `milestone-final-review` skill. Update `docs/milestones.md`, `PROJECT_STATE.md`, `README.md`, and write `docs/handoffs/m9_2-handoff.md`. Run `worktree-milestone-pr` to commit per-loop, push, and open the PR against `main`.

## Task spec format

Each `docs/tasks/M9_2-T00N-*.md` follows the existing M10-T0NN spec layout:

1. `# M9.2-T00N: <goal>`
2. `## Milestone` (one line: "M9.2: /save-log skill — Claude Code session transcript export").
3. `## Goal` (1–2 sentences).
4. `## Read first` (bullet list — at minimum: `docs/meeting-notes/2026-05-26-r1.md`, `docs/milestone-loop-protocol.md`, `docs/milestones.md §M9.2`, `CLAUDE.md`, plus any prior loop's closeout).
5. `## Scope` (numbered list).
6. `## Non-goals`.
7. `## Acceptance criteria` (bulleted PASS/FAIL conditions).
8. `## Permissions` (sandbox + git + DB).
9. `## Closeout format` (inline PASS/FAIL block).
10. `## Stop condition` (turn cap + "halt and ask" triggers).

## Acceptance criteria (rolled up)

The milestone passes when **all** are true:

- `.claude/skills/save-log/SKILL.md`, `scripts/save_claude_session_log.py`, `docs/logs/.gitkeep` exist.
- `/save-log <name|id>` against a real stopped/completed session writes `docs/logs/<name>.md` containing the header block (`Session name`, `Job id`, `Session id`, `Status`, `Source transcript`, `Output`, `Exported at`) plus the `claude-code-log --detail low --format md --compact` body.
- Running session selector → exits non-zero with a clear "not stopped/completed" message (unless `--allow-any-state`).
- Ambiguous fuzzy selector → exits non-zero with the candidate list.
- Secret-pattern hit → exits non-zero with the labels of detected patterns (unless `--allow-secret-like`).
- `ruff check scripts/save_claude_session_log.py` clean.
- `python -m pytest tests/` still passes (no regression — no new tests required, this is operator tooling).
- `docs/m9_2-final-review.md` exists and follows the M9 / M8.5 layout.
- `docs/milestones.md`, `PROJECT_STATE.md`, `README.md` are updated; `docs/handoffs/m9_2-handoff.md` is written.

## Risks & open issues

- **Skill-loader compatibility.** Unknown frontmatter keys could be rejected by the current Claude Code version. Mitigation: keep `name:` + `description:` as the load-bearing pair; document the extra keys as advisory.
- **`uvx` availability.** Arch dev box per memory has `uvx`; CI runners may not. The skill is operator-local — no CI dependency is created. If the smoke test in T001 fails because `uvx` is missing, halt and ask.
- **`~/.claude/projects` layout drift.** The script falls back through three locators (state.json paths → `**/<session-id>.jsonl` → `**/*<job_id>*.jsonl`). If Claude Code reorganises the directory, the locator may miss; documented in the script docstring.
- **Secret-pattern false positives.** Nine patterns from the meeting notes are conservative. Any real false positive on a legitimate transcript is closed with `--allow-secret-like` after human inspection; never by softening the patterns.
- **Transcript size.** `--detail low --compact` is the recommended preset; high-detail mode is intentionally not exposed in the skill body (`--detail` is a script arg, not a skill arg).

## Verification

1. `ls .claude/skills/save-log/SKILL.md scripts/save_claude_session_log.py docs/logs/.gitkeep` — all three exist.
2. `python scripts/save_claude_session_log.py --help` — exits 0, prints the four flags.
3. `ruff check scripts/save_claude_session_log.py` — clean.
4. `claude agents --json | jq -r '.[] | [.name, .sessionId, .status] | @tsv'` — pick one with `status in {completed, stopped}`.
5. `python scripts/save_claude_session_log.py <name-or-id>` — prints the JSON closeout, `docs/logs/<name>.md` exists.

7. `python scripts/save_claude_session_log.py <name-of-running-session>` — exits non-zero with the "not stopped/completed" message.
8. `python -m pytest tests/ -q` — green.
9. `gh pr create …` via `worktree-milestone-pr` opens the M9.2 PR.
````

````markdown
# Milestone Loop Protocol

_Shared rules that apply to every milestone Loop Prompt (M0+) unless a
milestone explicitly overrides one._

Each `docs/m*-loop-prompts.md` should reference this file once at the top
rather than duplicating the rules per prompt.

---

## 1. Sequencing

- Loop Prompts within a milestone MUST execute in order.
- Each prompt's **acceptance checks MUST pass** before moving to the next.
- On failure: fix the specific issue and **retry that prompt only**; do
  not skip ahead and do not redo prompts that already passed.

## 2. External systems and side effects

- Do NOT call the **real Anthropic API or Kaggle API** outside of paths
  the milestone explicitly designates as live; default to `--dry-run`.
- Do NOT run real **Kaggle submit / kernel push / dataset upload /
  model upload** unless the milestone explicitly requests it AND a
  human-approval record exists.
- Do NOT change **production Supabase**.

## 3. Database validation

- Use `SUPABASE_DB_URL=postgresql://postgres:s3cr3t@172.21.0.4:5432/postgres`
  — the `supabase-db` container on the local Docker network.
- Container IPs change on `docker compose down/up`; refresh with:
  ```bash
  docker inspect supabase-db \
    --format '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}'
  ```
- DB calls and LAN-host calls require `dangerouslyDisableSandbox=true`.
  Cloud LLM calls stay **inside** the sandbox.

## 4. Reporting

- Report **PASS / FAIL / SKIP** inline for each prompt's verification
  step.
- At milestone end, write the milestone's defined **Closeout format**
  (see each milestone's last Loop Prompt for the exact fields).

## 5. Git / GitHub — worktree mode

This project executes each milestone inside a dedicated **git worktree**
branched off `main`.

- **Mid-milestone, mid-prompt:** do not `git commit` or `git push`
  unless the individual task spec explicitly says so. Stage with
  `git add` and surface diffs in the inline report.
- **At milestone end** — once every Loop Prompt has PASSed and the
  milestone's Closeout has been written — Claude Code SHOULD:
  1. `git add` only the files listed in the Closeout's "files changed"
     section (or its equivalent).
  2. `git commit` using either:
     - one squash commit per milestone, OR
     - one commit per Loop Prompt,
     depending on the milestone's preference. The default is **one
     commit per Loop Prompt**, with the milestone's final review as the
     last commit.
  3. `git push` the worktree's branch to the remote.
  4. `gh pr create` against `main` using the milestone's
     `docs/m{N}-final-review.md` as the PR body.

- The following **still require explicit human approval** at any time:
  - `git push --force` (any branch)
  - `gh pr merge` (any PR)
  - any push to `main` directly
  - any `gh label create/edit/delete`, `gh issue edit/comment`,
    `gh pr edit/comment` against issues or PRs **not** owned by this
    milestone

- If the milestone's task spec or scope says
  "do not commit / push / open PRs", that override **wins** — typically
  used for planning-only or evidence-only milestones.

## 6. Secrets and forbidden reads

These are always denied, regardless of milestone:

- `.env*`
- `**/kaggle.json`, `~/.kaggle/kaggle.json`
- `~/.ssh/id_rsa`, `~/.ssh/id_ed25519`, any private key contents
- `~/.aws/**`, `~/.config/gcloud/**`
- `secrets/**`

Shell commands that would surface the above (`cat`, `grep`, `head`,
`tail`, `less`, `more`, file uploads) over these paths are blocked at
the hook layer.

---

## How a milestone references this file

In each Loop Prompt block, instead of repeating the rules above, include
one line near the top:

```
Follow: docs/milestone-loop-protocol.md
```

A milestone's `docs/m{N}-loop-prompts.md` should still spell out:

- the milestone's own scope, non-goals, and task list;
- per-Loop-Prompt read lists, scope, acceptance criteria;
- any **override** of a default in this file (e.g. a planning-only
  milestone overriding the worktree commit/push behavior).

````

````markdown
# M9.2 — Loop Prompts

_`/save-log` skill: export a stopped or completed Claude Code background
session transcript to `docs/logs/<session-name>.md` via `claude-code-log`._
_For sequential, partly autonomous execution on Arch Linux._
_Prerequisite: M9 merged on main (see `docs/m9-final-review.md`)._
_Shared rules: every Loop Prompt below MUST follow `docs/milestone-loop-protocol.md`
(sequencing, no real Kaggle/Anthropic outside designated approval paths,
DB DSN + sandbox bypass where it applies, **per-milestone worktree by
default**, secret denylist)._

---

## M9.2 at a glance

M9.2 is a **focused operator-tooling milestone**, not a Kaggle regression.
It adds a `/save-log <name|id>` slash command (Claude Code project skill)
that exports a stopped or completed background-session transcript to
`docs/logs/<session-name>.md` via the `claude-code-log` package (run
through `uvx`). The motivation is recorded in
`docs/meeting-notes/2026-05-26-r1.md`: `claude logs <session-id>` only
emits terminal output with ANSI cursor/control sequences; clean Markdown
for handoff packs must come from the transcript JSONL under
`~/.claude/projects/`.

M9.2 sits **between M9 (done) and M10 (in planning)**. It does not
renumber anything downstream. M10 remains the next executable Kaggle
milestone.

Direct entry into M9.2 is blocked until **all** are true:

- M9 is merged on main (`docs/m9-final-review.md` exists and reports PASS).
- The dev box has `uvx` available on `PATH` (`uvx --version` exits 0).
- `claude agents --json` lists at least one session belonging to this
  repository (used by M9.2-T001 as the smoke target).

### What's in scope

| Capability | Owned by | M9.2 touches |
|---|---|---|
| Skill discovery + invocation | `.claude/skills/save-log/SKILL.md` | T000 — new skill, `disable-model-invocation: true` |
| Session selector + transcript locator | `scripts/save_claude_session_log.py` | T000 — name / short job id / session id matching with longest-prefix scoring |
| Terminal-state gate | same script | T000 — refuses to export non-`stopped`/`completed` sessions unless `--allow-any-state` |
| Clean Markdown export | `uvx claude-code-log@latest … --detail low --format md --compact` | T000 — script wraps the CLI |
| Secret-pattern scan | same script | T000 — nine patterns from meeting notes §3 |
| Atomic overwrite | same script | T000 — write `.tmp.md` → `replace` |
| Smoke verification | T001 — exercise a real stopped/completed session + 3 negative paths | |
| Final review + PR | `milestone-final-review` skill + `worktree-milestone-pr` skill | T002 |

### What's NOT in scope

- Schema changes (no migration; `docs/logs/<name>.md` files do not get a
  `submissions` / `agent_run_artifacts` row in M9.2).
- Network side effects beyond `uvx` fetching `claude-code-log` from PyPI
  on first use.
- A `.claude/commands/save-log.md` fallback — skills override commands of
  the same name, so a duplicate would just be ambiguity.
- Automatic git commit of `docs/logs/*.md`. Humans review each export
  and commit by hand. `docs/logs/` is **not** gitignored — see T001.
- A model-invokable variant of the skill. `disable-model-invocation: true`
  is load-bearing — only a human typing `/save-log` may trigger it.
- A `claude logs` ANSI-strip fallback. The script fails loudly if the
  transcript JSONL cannot be located.
- CI coverage. The skill is operator-local; no new CI job is created.
- Reading `.env`, `~/.kaggle/kaggle.json`, `~/.ssh`, `~/.aws`,
  `~/.config/gcloud`, `~/.config/gh`, or anything else outside
  `~/.claude/projects/` and `~/.claude/jobs/`. The dev-phase secret
  carve-out in CLAUDE.md (and `feedback_permissive_github_dev_phase`
  memory) does **not** apply here — this script has no need to read
  credentials.

DB / sandbox details: M9.2 does not require Supabase or a sandbox bypass.
The script makes no network call other than what `uvx` itself does to
install `claude-code-log` from PyPI on first use; PyPI is on the sandbox
allowlist, so no `dangerouslyDisableSandbox` should be needed.

## Rollback / stop criteria

Stop the milestone — do **not** advance to the next Loop Prompt — if any
of these is true:

- `uvx` is unavailable on the dev box and cannot be installed without
  asking. Halt and ask; do not silently shell out to `pip install`.
- `claude-code-log` rejects the `--format md / --detail low / --compact`
  flag combination on the version `uvx` resolves to. Halt and ask
  before pinning a different version.
- The script reads any file outside `~/.claude/projects/` or
  `~/.claude/jobs/` (e.g. accidentally globs `.env` or `kaggle.json`).
  This is a security regression — halt and rewrite the locator.
- The secret-pattern scan trips on every real transcript (false-positive
  storm). Halt and ask — do not soften the patterns; the patterns are
  the safety net.
- The skill loader silently drops `save-log` (e.g. unknown frontmatter
  rejected, or directory layout mismatched). Halt and ask; do not
  switch to `.claude/commands/save-log.md` without confirmation.
- A real export of a session containing a known secret (e.g. a test
  transcript with a deliberate `sk-ant-…`) succeeds without
  `--allow-secret-like`. Halt and rotate the credential.

If M9.2 surfaces a follow-up that doesn't fit the milestone (e.g. a
`/save-log --all` mode, a Supabase artifact promotion, a transcript
post-processor), file it as a new issue and continue with M9.2 as
scoped — do not expand scope mid-milestone.
````

````markdown
# M9.2-T000: `/save-log` skill scaffold + script implementation

## Milestone
M9.2: `/save-log` skill — Claude Code session transcript export.

## Goal
Create the project skill at `.claude/skills/save-log/SKILL.md`, the
backing Python script at `scripts/save_claude_session_log.py`, and the
empty `docs/logs/.gitkeep` placeholder. Implement the script verbatim
from `docs/meeting-notes/2026-05-26-r1.md` §3, with the read-list
restrictions documented below. Confirm the script parses, `ruff` is
clean, and `uvx` + `claude-code-log` are reachable. No real session is
exported in this task — that is T001's job.

## Read first

1. `docs/meeting-notes/2026-05-26-r1.md` — canonical spec, §2 (SKILL.md)
   and §3 (Python script).
2. `docs/milestones.md` §M9.2.
3. `docs/m9_2-loop-prompts.md` — milestone shape.
4. `docs/milestone-loop-protocol.md` — sequencing + secret denylist.
5. `CLAUDE.md` — note that the dev-phase secret carve-out does **not**
   apply here (this script has no need to read credentials).
6. `.claude/skills/worktree-milestone-pr/SKILL.md` — skill frontmatter
   precedent (`name:` + `description:` only).
7. `.claude/skills/kg-nb/SKILL.md` — another skill precedent.
8. `scripts/README.md` — script-directory conventions.

## Scope

1. Create `.claude/skills/save-log/` and write `SKILL.md` with the
   frontmatter and body from meeting-notes §2:

   ```yaml
   ---
   name: save-log
   description: Export a stopped or completed Claude Code background session transcript to docs/logs/<session-name>.md using claude-code-log.
   argument-hint: "<name|id>"
   arguments:
     - session
   allowed-tools:
     - Bash(python scripts/save_claude_session_log.py*)
   disable-model-invocation: true
   tags:
     - logging
     - handoff
     - claude-code
   ---

   !`python scripts/save_claude_session_log.py "$session"`
   ```

   If the active Claude Code loader silently drops any of
   `argument-hint`, `arguments`, `allowed-tools`,
   `disable-model-invocation`, or `tags`, that is acceptable — keep
   them in the file so future loader versions pick them up. If the
   loader **rejects** the file outright (refuses to register
   `/save-log`), trim to `name:` + `description:` only and document the
   trim in the closeout.

2. Create `scripts/save_claude_session_log.py` verbatim from
   meeting-notes §3 (lines 176–666). Honour these read-list
   restrictions when copying:
   - The script reads only `~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl`,
````

````markdown
# M9.2-T001: `/save-log` smoke + negative paths + doc note

## Milestone
M9.2: `/save-log` skill — Claude Code session transcript export.

## Goal
Exercise the newly-implemented `/save-log` skill end-to-end against a
real stopped or completed Claude Code background session, then verify
the three negative paths (running session, ambiguous selector, secret
match). Add a brief `/save-log` mention to `README.md`. Confirm
`docs/logs/` stays un-gitignored.

## Read first

1. `docs/tasks/M9_2-T000-save-log-scaffold-and-impl.md` and its
   closeout.
2. `docs/meeting-notes/2026-05-26-r1.md` §5 (validation flow).
3. `scripts/save_claude_session_log.py` (the just-landed script).
4. `.claude/skills/save-log/SKILL.md`.
5. `README.md` — current-milestone block + tooling section.
6. `.gitignore` — confirm `docs/logs/` is not listed.

## Scope

1. List Claude Code background sessions and pick one that is `completed`
   or `stopped` and belongs to this repo:

   ```bash
   claude agents --json | jq -r '.[] | [.name, .sessionId, .status, .cwd] | @tsv'
   ```

   Record the chosen `name`, `sessionId`, and `status` in the closeout.
   Prefer the M9 / M10 closeout sessions if they are listed. Do NOT
   pick a running session for the positive smoke.

2. Run the script against the chosen session:

   ```bash
   python scripts/save_claude_session_log.py "<name-or-id>"
   ```

   Confirm:
   - Exit code 0.
   - JSON output prints `ok: true`, the matched selector, and the
     resolved transcript path.
   - `docs/logs/<safe-name>.md` exists.
   - The output file's first 30 lines contain the header block (lines
     starting with `- Exported at:`, `- Session name:`, `- Job id:`,
     `- Session id:`, `- Status:`, `- Source transcript:`, `- Output:`)
     and a `---` separator before the body.
   - The body is Markdown — no ANSI escape sequences
     (`\x1b[`/`\033[`), no terminal control codes.
   - File ends with a single trailing newline.

3. **Negative path A — running session.** Pick a session whose status
   is `running` / `working` (or `start` a fresh one if none exists).
   Run:

   ```bash
   python scripts/save_claude_session_log.py "<running-name-or-id>"
   ```

   Confirm:
   - Exit code 1.
   - Stderr contains "not stopped/completed" or equivalent, plus the
     hint to use `--allow-any-state`.
   - No `docs/logs/<name>.md` is written.

4. **Negative path B — ambiguous fuzzy selector.** Choose a substring
   that matches multiple agent names (e.g. `m` if two sessions start
   with `m`). Run:

   ```bash
   python scripts/save_claude_session_log.py "<ambiguous-substring>"
   ```

   Confirm:
   - Exit code 1.
   - Stderr contains "Ambiguous session selector" and lists the
     candidates (name / job_id / session_id / status / source).
   - No `docs/logs/<name>.md` is written.

   If no natural ambiguity exists in the current `claude agents`
   output, document that fact in the closeout and synthesize a
   minimal test by temporarily renaming two sessions to share a
   prefix; restore the names afterwards.

5. **Negative path C — secret-pattern hit.** Take the export from step
   2, copy it to a temp file, and append a line containing
   `sk-**********************************pqr` (a clearly-fake but
   pattern-matching string). Reset the transcript locator by
   placing the temp file at a path the locator can find — easiest:
   write a synthetic `.jsonl` with one message containing the
   secret-like substring under `$TMPDIR/save-log-secret-test/` and
   point `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` at a fake config dir containing a
   matching state.json. Then run:

   ```bash
   python scripts/save_claude_session_log.py "secret-test"
   ```

   Confirm:
   - Exit code 1.
   - Stderr contains "secret-like patterns detected" and lists at
     least one of the nine pattern labels (e.g. "Anthropic API key"
     or "generic sk-* API key").
   - No `docs/logs/secret-test.md` is written.

   Then re-run with `--allow-secret-like` and confirm the file IS
   written. Delete the synthetic `docs/logs/secret-test.md` after the
   check — do not commit it.

   If wiring a synthetic `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` is too invasive, the
   acceptable fallback is to monkey-patch the `SECRET_PATTERNS` test
   inline in a one-off Python REPL run that scans a known-secret
   string and assert at least one pattern matches; document the
   fallback in the closeout.

6. Add a one-line `/save-log` mention to `README.md` under whichever
   section lists project skills / operator tooling. Wording suggestion:

   ```markdown
   - `/save-log <name|id>` — export a stopped or completed Claude Code
     background session transcript to `docs/logs/<name>.md` via
     `claude-code-log`. See `.claude/skills/save-log/SKILL.md`.
   ```

7. Confirm `docs/logs/` is **not** in `.gitignore`. If it is, halt and
   ask — this is a milestone decision (see `docs/m9_2-loop-prompts.md`
   §"Human decisions").

8. Do **not** commit `docs/logs/<name>.md` from step 2. The export is
   evidence for the closeout; the human reviewer decides per-export
   whether to commit. Keep it locally during the milestone; the
   milestone PR opened by T002 may or may not include it (T002's
   call).

9. Run `python -m pytest tests/ -q`. Must be green (no regression).

## Non-goals

- Do not add new pytest cases under `tests/`.
- Do not change `scripts/save_claude_session_log.py` other than to fix
  bugs surfaced by the smoke tests. If a behavioural change is needed,
  open a follow-up issue and patch in a separate PR.
- Do not delete or rename existing `claude agents` sessions for the
  ambiguity test without restoring them afterwards.
- Do not commit `docs/logs/*.md` other than `.gitkeep`. T002 decides
  whether the smoke-test export goes in the M9.2 PR.

## Acceptance criteria

- Positive smoke: a real `docs/logs/<name>.md` exists with the header
  block and a Markdown body free of ANSI escapes.
- Negative A (running session): exit 1 with the expected message; no
  file written.
- Negative B (ambiguous selector): exit 1 with the candidate list; no
  file written.
- Negative C (secret pattern): exit 1 with the pattern label; re-run
  with `--allow-secret-like` succeeds.
- `README.md` mentions `/save-log` in at least one place.
- `.gitignore` does **not** contain `docs/logs/`.
- `python -m pytest tests/ -q` still passes.

## Permissions

- Local file reads and writes inside the worktree are allowed.
- `~/.claude/projects/`, `~/.claude/jobs/`, and `claude agents --json`
  may be read.
- `~/.kaggle/kaggle.json`, `.env*`, `~/.ssh/**`, `~/.aws/**`,
  `~/.config/gcloud/**`, `~/.config/gh/**`, and `secrets/**` are not
  read.
- `git commit` and `git push` are **not** allowed in this task.
- No DB calls; no `dangerouslyDisableSandbox`.

## Closeout format

```

  Output: docs/logs/<name>.md (size=<bytes>, ANSI-free=YES)
````

```bash
## Summary

Planning artifacts for **M9.2**, an operator-tooling milestone slotted between M9 (done) and M10 (in planning). No code in this PR — implementation happens when the loop-runner executes M9.2-T000.

M9.2 adds a `/save-log <name|id>` Claude Code project skill that exports a stopped or completed background-session transcript to `docs/logs/<session-name>.md` via `claude-code-log` (run through `uvx`). The skill is operator-local (`disable-model-invocation: true`), backed by a Python script with a nine-pattern secret-scan refusal, terminal-state gate, and atomic overwrite.

Canonical spec: `docs/meeting-notes/2026-05-26-r1.md`. The motivation: `claude logs <session-id>` only emits ANSI terminal output; clean Markdown for handoff packs must come from the transcript JSONL under `~/.claude/projects/`.

### Files added

- `docs/m9_2-loop-prompts.md` — 3 Loop Prompts, M10-style.
- `docs/tasks/M9_2-T000-save-log-scaffold-and-impl.md` — scaffold SKILL.md + script verbatim from meeting-notes §3 + `docs/logs/.gitkeep`; ruff + `--help` checks; no real export.
- `docs/tasks/M9_2-T001-save-log-smoke-and-docs.md` — positive smoke against a real stopped/completed session + three negative paths (running, ambiguous, secret-pattern) + README mention.
- `docs/tasks/M9_2-T002-m9_2-exit-criteria.md` — validation matrix + `docs/m9_2-final-review.md` + milestones/PROJECT_STATE/README updates + handoff + `worktree-milestone-pr` PR.

### Files updated

### Design choices (confirmed in planning conversation)

1. **Milestone slot.** M9.2 between M9 (done) and M10 (open). M10–M13 numbering stays.
2. **Loop granularity.** Three Loop Prompts (scaffold+impl / smoke / closeout), matching M10's per-task cadence.
3. **Logs in git.** `docs/logs/*.md` is **not** gitignored. Exports are repo-eligible after human review; the secret-pattern scan in the script is the safety net.
4. **Skill-only, not command.** No `.claude/commands/save-log.md` — skills override commands of the same name; a duplicate would just be ambiguity.
5. **No model-invokable variant.** `disable-model-invocation: true` is load-bearing; only a human typing `/save-log` may trigger the skill.
6. **Stricter than CLAUDE.md secret carve-out.** The script does not read `.env`, `~/.kaggle/kaggle.json`, `~/.ssh`, `~/.aws`, `~/.config/gcloud`, or `~/.config/gh` — it has no need for credentials. Only `~/.claude/projects/` and `~/.claude/jobs/` are read.

## Test plan

This is a planning-only PR; the test plan is the **next** milestone's validation matrix (M9.2-T002), not this PR's. For this PR, reviewers should check:

- [ ] `docs/m9_2-loop-prompts.md` matches the structural shape of `docs/m10-loop-prompts.md` (at-a-glance, in-scope/out-of-scope, approval gates, stop criteria, runbook).

- [ ] No code, no schema, no CI changes land in this PR.

## Remote side effects

- [ ] Real Anthropic API call (none — planning only).
- [ ] Production Supabase write (none).
- [ ] New external dependency: `uvx` + `claude-code-log` will be exercised when the loop-runner picks up M9.2-T000; documented in the milestone's stop criteria.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
EOF
```

````markdown
---

# save-log — export Claude Code session transcript to docs/logs/

Use this skill to turn a **stopped** or **completed** Claude Code
background-session transcript into a clean Markdown file under
`docs/logs/<session-name>.md`, ready for handoff packs or milestone
evidence.

## Usage

```text
/save-log <name|id>
```

Examples:

```text
/save-log M7
/save-log 01F8ABC
/save-log 01F8ABCDEF1234567890
```

Prefer a Claude Code **agent name** or **short job id** for the selector.
If the agent name has spaces, use an id; or rename the agent to a
slug-like string (`M7`, `m9-2-impl`, …) first.

## How it works

The skill shells out to `python scripts/save_claude_session_log.py
"$session"`, which:

1. Lists candidate sessions via `claude agents --json` and
   `~/.claude/jobs/*/state.json`.
2. Picks the best match for `<name|id>` (exact / prefix / substring
   scoring; ambiguous fuzzy matches fail loudly).
3. Refuses to export anything that is not `completed` or `stopped`
   unless `--allow-any-state` is set.
4. Locates the transcript JSONL under `~/.claude/projects/` (no
   fallback to `claude logs` terminal output — ANSI escape sequences
   would corrupt the export).
5. Calls `uvx claude-code-log@latest --detail low --format md
   --compact` to render clean Markdown.
6. Runs a nine-pattern secret scan on the rendered output and refuses
   to write if any pattern matches, unless `--allow-secret-like` is
   set.
7. Writes atomically to `docs/logs/<safe-name>.md` (overwrites any
   previous export with the same name).

## Output

`docs/logs/<safe-name>.md` with a small header block (Exported at,
Session name, Job id, Session id, Status, Source transcript, Output)
followed by the `claude-code-log --detail low --compact` body.

The script also prints a JSON closeout to stdout:

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "output": "docs/logs/m9_2-impl.md",
  "matched": {
    "name": "m9_2-impl",
    "job_id": "...",
    "session_id": "...",
    "status": "completed",
    "source": "claude agents --json"
  },
  "transcript": "/home/.../<session-id>.jsonl"
}
```

## Safety rules

- Reads only `~/.claude/projects/`, `~/.claude/jobs/`, and the stdout
  of `claude agents --json`. Does not read `.env*`,
  `~/.kaggle/kaggle.json`, `~/.ssh/**`, `~/.aws/**`,
  `~/.config/gcloud/**`, `~/.config/gh/**`, or `secrets/**` — even
  though the CLAUDE.md dev-phase carve-out allows some of those, this
  skill has no need for credentials.
- `disable-model-invocation: true` — only a human typing `/save-log`
  may trigger this skill. The model must not invoke it
  programmatically.
- Refuses to write if any of the nine secret patterns in
  `SECRET_PATTERNS` match the rendered transcript. Override with
  `--allow-secret-like` only after inspecting the transcript by hand.

## Out of scope

- No commit of `docs/logs/<name>.md`. The human decides per-export
  whether to commit (default: don't, unless evidentially load-bearing).
- No `claude logs` ANSI-strip fallback. If the transcript JSONL can't
  be located, the script fails loudly with the exact `find` hint.
- No `--all` mode. One session per invocation.

## Reference

Design rationale and the canonical reference implementation:
`docs/meeting-notes/2026-05-26-r1.md`.
````

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Export a stopped/completed Claude Code background session to docs/logs/<name>.md.

This script intentionally exports from Claude Code transcript JSONL via
`claude-code-log`, rather than from `claude logs`, because terminal output can
contain ANSI cursor/control sequences.

Read-list discipline: this script reads only ~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl,
~/.claude/jobs/*/state.json, and the stdout of `claude agents --json`. It does
NOT read .env*, ~/.kaggle/kaggle.json, ~/.ssh/**, ~/.aws/**,
~/.config/gcloud/**, ~/.config/gh/**, or secrets/**. The CLAUDE.md dev-phase
carve-out does not apply here — this script has no need for credentials.

Usage:
    python scripts/save_claude_session_log.py M7
    python scripts/save_claude_session_log.py <session-id>
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Iterable


TERMINAL_STATUSES = {"completed", "complete", "stopped", "stop"}

SECRET_PATTERNS: list[tuple[str, str]] = [
    (r"github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}", "GitHub fine-grained PAT"),
    (r"\bgh[opsu]_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}", "GitHub token"),
    (r"\bsk-ant-[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{20,}", "Anthropic API key"),
    (r"\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{32,}", "generic sk-* API key"),
    (r"BEGIN (?:RSA |OPENSSH |EC |DSA )?PRIVATE KEY", "private key block"),
    (r"\bANTHROPIC_API_KEY\s*=\s*['\"]?[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{16,}", "Anthropic env key"),
    (r"\bOPENAI_API_KEY\s*=\s*['\"]?[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{16,}", "OpenAI env key"),
    (r"\bKAGGLE_KEY\s*=\s*['\"]?[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{8,}", "Kaggle key"),
    (r"\bSUPABASE_[A-Z0-9_]*KEY\s*=\s*['\"]?[A-Za-z0-9_\-.]{16,}", "Supabase key"),
    (
        r"\b(?:password|passwd|secret|token)\s*[:=]\s*['\"]?[A-Za-z0-9_\-.]{16,}",
        "generic secret assignment",
    ),
]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Candidate:
    source: str
    job_id: str
    session_id: str
    name: str
    status: str
    cwd: str
    state_path: Path | None
    raw: dict[str, Any]


def eprint(msg: str) -> None:
    print(msg, file=sys.stderr)


def run(
    cmd: list[str], *, cwd: Path | None = None, timeout: int = 30
) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
    return subprocess.run(
        cmd,
        cwd=str(cwd) if cwd else None,
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
        timeout=timeout,
        check=False,
    )


def project_root() -> Path:
    env_dir = os.environ.get("CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR")
    if env_dir:
        return Path(env_dir).expanduser().resolve()

    proc = run(["git", "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"], timeout=10)
    if proc.returncode == 0 and proc.stdout.strip():
        return Path(proc.stdout.strip()).resolve()

    return Path.cwd().resolve()


def claude_config_dir() -> Path:
    return Path(os.environ.get("CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR", "~/.claude")).expanduser().resolve()


def walk_json(obj: Any) -> Iterable[Any]:
    yield obj
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        for value in obj.values():
            yield from walk_json(value)
    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        for value in obj:
            yield from walk_json(value)


def first_value(obj: Any, keys: set[str]) -> str:
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        for key in keys:
            value = obj.get(key)
            if value not in (None, ""):
                return str(value)

        for value in obj.values():
            found = first_value(value, keys)
            if found:
                return found

    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        for value in obj:
            found = first_value(value, keys)
            if found:
                return found

    return ""


def collect_jsonl_paths(obj: Any) -> list[Path]:
    paths: list[Path] = []
    for value in walk_json(obj):
        if isinstance(value, str) and value.endswith(".jsonl"):
            paths.append(Path(value).expanduser())
    return paths


def normalise_status(value: str) -> str:
    value = (value or "").strip().lower()
    if value in {"done", "success", "succeeded"}:
        return "completed"
    if value in {"cancelled", "canceled"}:
        return "stopped"
    return value


def related_to_project(cwd: str, root: Path) -> bool:
    if not cwd:
        return True

    try:
        p = Path(cwd).expanduser().resolve()
    except Exception:
        return True

    return p == root or root in p.parents or p in root.parents


def candidate_from_raw(
    raw: dict[str, Any],
    *,
    source: str,
    job_id: str = "",
    state_path: Path | None = None,
) -> Candidate:
    session_id = first_value(
        raw,
        {"sessionId", "session_id", "transcriptSessionId", "transcript_session_id"},
    )
    name = first_value(raw, {"name", "displayName", "display_name", "title"})
    status = first_value(raw, {"status", "state", "lifecycleState", "lifecycle_state"})
    cwd = first_value(
        raw, {"cwd", "workingDirectory", "working_dir", "projectDir", "project_dir"}
    )

    if not job_id and state_path is not None:
        try:
            job_id = state_path.parent.name
        except Exception:
            job_id = ""

    return Candidate(
        source=source,
        job_id=job_id,
        session_id=session_id,
        name=name,
        status=normalise_status(status),
        cwd=cwd,
        state_path=state_path,
        raw=raw,
    )


def load_agents_from_cli(root: Path) -> list[Candidate]:
    proc = run(["claude", "agents", "--cwd", str(root), "--json"], cwd=root, timeout=20)
    if proc.returncode != 0 or not proc.stdout.strip():
        return []

    try:
        data = json.loads(proc.stdout)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        return []

    if not isinstance(data, list):
        return []

    out: list[Candidate] = []
    for item in data:
        if isinstance(item, dict):
            c = candidate_from_raw(item, source="claude agents --json")
            if related_to_project(c.cwd, root):
                out.append(c)
    return out


def load_agents_from_state_files(config_dir: Path, root: Path) -> list[Candidate]:
    jobs_dir = config_dir / "jobs"
    if not jobs_dir.exists():
        return []

    out: list[Candidate] = []
    for state_path in sorted(jobs_dir.glob("*/state.json")):
        try:
            raw = json.loads(state_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except Exception:
            continue

        if not isinstance(raw, dict):
            continue

        c = candidate_from_raw(raw, source="state.json", state_path=state_path)
        if related_to_project(c.cwd, root):
            out.append(c)

    return out


def dedupe(candidates: list[Candidate]) -> list[Candidate]:
    seen: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()
    out: list[Candidate] = []
    for c in candidates:
        key = (c.job_id, c.session_id, c.name)
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        out.append(c)
    return out


def score_candidate(target: str, c: Candidate) -> int:
    t = target.strip()
    tl = t.lower()
    score = 0

    fields = [
        (c.job_id, 100),
        (c.session_id, 95),
        (c.name, 90),
    ]

    for value, exact_score in fields:
        if not value:
            continue
        vl = value.lower()
        if vl == tl:
            score = max(score, exact_score)
        elif vl.startswith(tl):
            score = max(score, exact_score - 10)
        elif tl in vl and exact_score == 90:
            score = max(score, 50)

    return score


def describe_candidate(c: Candidate) -> str:
    return (
        f"name={c.name or '-'} "
        f"job_id={c.job_id or '-'} "
        f"session_id={c.session_id or '-'} "
        f"status={c.status or '-'} "
        f"source={c.source}"
    )


def select_candidate(target: str, candidates: list[Candidate]) -> Candidate:
    scored = [(score_candidate(target, c), c) for c in candidates]
    scored = [(score, c) for score, c in scored if score > 0]

    if not scored:
        available = "\n".join(f"  - {describe_candidate(c)}" for c in candidates[:30])
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"No Claude background session matched {target!r}.\n"
            f"Available project sessions:\n{available or '  (none found)'}"
        )

    scored.sort(key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True)
    best_score = scored[0][0]
    best = [c for score, c in scored if score == best_score]

    unique_keys = {(c.job_id, c.session_id, c.name) for c in best}
    if len(unique_keys) > 1 and best_score < 90:
        choices = "\n".join(f"  - {describe_candidate(c)}" for c in best)
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"Ambiguous session selector {target!r}. Use an id instead.\n{choices}"
        )

    return best[0]


def find_transcript_from_state(candidate: Candidate, config_dir: Path) -> Path | None:
    for path in collect_jsonl_paths(candidate.raw):
        if not path.is_absolute():
            path = (
                candidate.state_path.parent if candidate.state_path else config_dir
            ) / path
        if path.exists():
            return path.resolve()

    if candidate.session_id:
        matches = list((config_dir / "projects").glob(f"**/{candidate.session_id}.jsonl"))
        if matches:
            return matches[0].resolve()

    if candidate.job_id:
        matches = list((config_dir / "projects").glob(f"**/*{candidate.job_id}*.jsonl"))
        if matches:
            return matches[0].resolve()

    return None


def safe_filename(name: str) -> str:
    text = name.strip() or "claude-session"
    text = re.sub(r"[^\w.\-]+", "-", text, flags=re.UNICODE)
    text = re.sub(r"-{2,}", "-", text).strip(".-")
    return text[:120] or "claude-session"


def run_claude_code_log(transcript: Path, tmp_md: Path, detail: str) -> None:
    uvx = shutil.which("uvx")
    if not uvx:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "uvx not found. Install uv first, then run: uvx claude-code-log@latest --help"
        )

    attempts: list[list[str]] = []
    for fmt in ("md", "markdown"):
        for output_flag in ("-o", "--output"):
            attempts.append(
                [
                    uvx,
                    "claude-code-log@latest",
                    str(transcript),
                    "--detail",
                    detail,
                    "--format",
                    fmt,
                    "--compact",
                    output_flag,
                    str(tmp_md),
                ]
            )
        attempts.append(
            [
                uvx,
                "claude-code-log@latest",
                str(transcript),
                "--detail",
                detail,
                "--format",
                fmt,
                "--compact",
            ]
        )

    errors: list[str] = []
    for cmd in attempts:
        proc = run(cmd, timeout=180)

        if cmd[-1] == str(tmp_md):
            if proc.returncode == 0 and tmp_md.exists() and tmp_md.stat().st_size > 0:
                return
        else:
            if proc.returncode == 0 and proc.stdout.strip():
                tmp_md.write_text(proc.stdout, encoding="utf-8")
                return

        errors.append(
            "$ "
            + " ".join(cmd)
            + "\n"
            + f"returncode={proc.returncode}\n"
            + f"stderr={proc.stderr[-2000:]}"
        )

    raise RuntimeError("claude-code-log failed.\n\n" + "\n\n---\n\n".join(errors[-3:]))


def scan_secret_like_text(text: str) -> list[str]:
    hits: list[str] = []
    for pattern, label in SECRET_PATTERNS:
        if re.search(pattern, text, flags=re.IGNORECASE):
            hits.append(label)
    return hits


def build_header(candidate: Candidate, transcript: Path, output_path: Path) -> str:
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
    title = candidate.name or candidate.job_id or candidate.session_id or "Claude session"
    return (
        f"# Claude session log: {title}\n\n"
        f"- Exported at: `{now}`\n"
        f"- Session name: `{candidate.name or ''}`\n"
        f"- Job id: `{candidate.job_id or ''}`\n"
        f"- Session id: `{candidate.session_id or ''}`\n"
        f"- Status: `{candidate.status or ''}`\n"
        f"- Source transcript: `{transcript}`\n"
        f"- Output: `{output_path}`\n\n"
        "---\n\n"
    )


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument(
        "selector",
        help="Claude background session name, short job id, or session id",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--allow-any-state",
        action="store_true",
        help="Export even if session is not completed/stopped",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--allow-secret-like",
        action="store_true",
        help="Write even if secret-like patterns are found",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--detail",
        default="low",
        choices=["low", "medium", "high"],
        help="claude-code-log detail level",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output-dir",
        default="docs/logs",
        help="output directory, relative to repo root",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    root = project_root()
    config_dir = claude_config_dir()

    candidates = dedupe(
        load_agents_from_cli(root) + load_agents_from_state_files(config_dir, root)
    )

    candidate = select_candidate(args.selector, candidates)

    if not args.allow_any_state and candidate.status not in TERMINAL_STATUSES:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"Matched session is not stopped/completed: {describe_candidate(candidate)}\n"
            f"Stop it first with `claude stop <id>` or rerun with --allow-any-state."
        )

    transcript = find_transcript_from_state(candidate, config_dir)
    if transcript is None:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"Could not find transcript JSONL for session: {describe_candidate(candidate)}\n"
            f"Try `claude --resume` to locate the session, or search:\n"
            f"  find {config_dir}/projects -name '*.jsonl' | grep '<session-id>'"
        )

    output_dir = (root / args.output_dir).resolve()
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    out_name = safe_filename(
        candidate.name or candidate.job_id or candidate.session_id or args.selector
    )
    output_path = output_dir / f"{out_name}.md"

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="save-claude-log-") as tmp_dir_s:
        tmp_dir = Path(tmp_dir_s)
        tmp_md = tmp_dir / "session.md"

        run_claude_code_log(transcript, tmp_md, args.detail)

        body = tmp_md.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        final_text = build_header(candidate, transcript, output_path) + body.rstrip() + "\n"

        hits = scan_secret_like_text(final_text)
        if hits and not args.allow_secret_like:
            labels = ", ".join(sorted(set(hits)))
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Refusing to write {output_path}: secret-like patterns detected: {labels}.\n"
                f"Manually inspect the transcript, redact sensitive content, or rerun with --allow-secret-like."
            )

        tmp_out = output_path.with_suffix(".tmp.md")
        tmp_out.write_text(final_text, encoding="utf-8")
        tmp_out.replace(output_path)

    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "ok": True,
                "output": str(output_path.relative_to(root)),
                "matched": {
                    "name": candidate.name,
                    "job_id": candidate.job_id,
                    "session_id": candidate.session_id,
                    "status": candidate.status,
                    "source": candidate.source,
                },
                "transcript": str(transcript),
            },
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )
    )
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main())
    except Exception as exc:
        eprint(f"ERROR: {exc}")
        raise SystemExit(1)
```

```python
"""End-to-end gate test: rendered text with a secret -> RuntimeError; --allow-secret-like override -> file written."""
import sys, json, tempfile, shutil
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path('/home/harry/test/tt_pangu/.claude/worktrees/m9_2-impl')
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'scripts'))
import save_claude_session_log as scl

# Simulate the post-render text the main() loop would scan
candidate = scl.Candidate(
    source='test',
    job_id='gate-job',
    session_id='gate-session',
    name='secret-gate',
    status='completed',
    cwd=str(ROOT),
    state_path=None,
    raw={},
)
fake_transcript = Path('/dev/null')
fake_output = ROOT / 'docs/logs/gate.md'

# Patch run_claude_code_log to write text containing a secret-like string.
SECRET = 'sk-*******************************************EEF'

def fake_render(transcript, tmp_md, detail):
    tmp_md.write_text(f"# fake session\n\nuser: please remember key {SECRET}\n", encoding='utf-8')

scl.run_claude_code_log = fake_render

# Path 1: gate refuses (no --allow-secret-like)
import argparse
def fake_args(allow_secret_like, allow_any_state=False, detail='low', output_dir='docs/logs', selector='secret-gate'):
    n = argparse.Namespace()
    n.selector = selector
    n.allow_any_state = allow_any_state
    n.allow_secret_like = allow_secret_like
    n.detail = detail
    n.output_dir = output_dir
    return n

# Patch parse_args + the candidate loader so main() picks up our test candidate
orig_parse = argparse.ArgumentParser.parse_args
import save_claude_session_log as scl2
scl2.load_agents_from_cli = lambda root: [candidate]
scl2.load_agents_from_state_files = lambda cfg, root: []
scl2.find_transcript_from_state = lambda c, cfg: fake_transcript

print('Path 1: gate refuses (no --allow-secret-like)')
argparse.ArgumentParser.parse_args = lambda self: fake_args(allow_secret_like=False)
try:
    scl2.main()
    print('  FAIL: gate did not refuse')
except SystemExit:
    print('  ?? SystemExit (not expected)')
except RuntimeError as e:
    msg = str(e)
    print(f'  PASS: RuntimeError raised; first line: {msg.splitlines()[0]}')
    assert 'secret-like patterns detected' in msg
    assert not fake_output.exists() or fake_output.stat().st_size == 0
finally:
    argparse.ArgumentParser.parse_args = orig_parse

print()
print('Path 2: --allow-secret-like overrides; file is written')
argparse.ArgumentParser.parse_args = lambda self: fake_args(allow_secret_like=True)
try:
    if fake_output.exists():
        fake_output.unlink()
    rc = scl2.main()
    print(f'  rc={rc}')
    assert fake_output.exists(), 'gate.md missing'
    body = fake_output.read_text()
    assert SECRET in body, 'secret not in body'
    print(f'  PASS: file written ({fake_output.stat().st_size} bytes), secret present in body')
    fake_output.unlink()
    print('  cleaned up docs/logs/gate.md')
finally:
    argparse.ArgumentParser.parse_args = orig_parse

```

````markdown
### Running the KCA CLI

```bash
kca skill list                        # list available agent workflow recipes
kca skill show run-milestone          # inspect a skill
kca skill run run-milestone docs/tasks/M7-T001.md --dry-run
kca job list                          # list jobs
kca decision list                     # list pending approval gates
kca local probe                       # check local GPU endpoint status
```

### Cloud deployment (placeholder — not yet implemented)

The platform is designed to run locally first. Cloud deployment will be added in a future milestone. Planned targets:

- **AWS**: ECS/Fargate for worker containers, RDS or Supabase hosted for DB, S3 for artifact storage, SQS/EventBridge for job queue.
- **GCP**: Cloud Run for workers, Cloud SQL or Supabase hosted for DB, GCS for artifacts, Cloud Tasks for job queue.

When cloud deployment is ready, a `docs/deployment/` directory will contain per-provider runbooks. Environment variable `KCA_DEPLOY_TARGET=local|aws|gcp` will select the active runtime. All remote write operations will still require `KCA_ALLOW_REMOTE=1` and human approval gates.

## Safety rules summary

- Secrets never enter repo, prompts, logs, or screenshots.
- Kaggle submissions, kernel pushes, and dataset uploads require explicit human approval.
- CTF/lab work must be local/sandboxed or explicitly authorized.
````

```markdown
## DB access note

DB validation reused the M5/M6/M7/M8/M8.5 path: container IP DSN
`postgresql://postgres:s3cr3t@172.21.0.4:5432/postgres`. The container
IP rotates on `docker compose down/up`; refresh via
`docker inspect supabase-db --format '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}'`.

DB checks that needed `dangerouslyDisableSandbox=true`:
- `kca run list --competition spaceship-titanic --json` (READ_ONLY against `experiment_runs`, `experiments`, `run_metrics`).
- `submissions` row inspection via `psql`.
- Live-DB pytest sweep (98 passed / 0 skipped when `.env` is shadowed to an empty file in a tmp tree — see "Known caveat" below).

Live-DB pytest **inside the dev shell** surfaces 3 pre-existing failures
that are not M9 regressions:

- `tests/test_kca_smoke.py::test_kaggle_submit_blocked_without_env`
- `tests/test_m4_smoke.py::test_kaggle_submit_no_credentials`
- `tests/test_m9_e2e.py::test_kca_kaggle_submit_refuses_without_credentials`

Root cause: `tools/kca/db.py` calls `dotenv.load_dotenv(<repo-root>/.env, override=False)` at import time. With the sandbox engaged, `.env` is bind-mounted to `/dev/null` (loads nothing — tests PASS, see row 26 above). With `dangerouslyDisableSandbox=true` the real `.env` becomes readable and re-injects `KAGGLE_USERNAME`/`KAGGLE_KEY` into the subprocess environment, so the "refuses without credentials" assertion fails. This is **cross-cutting follow-up B** (M8.5 carry-over → M10). Both sandbox-mode pytest and the shadow-tree pytest (`tmp/.../.env` empty) are clean — only the unshadowed live-DB run on a host shell with a populated `.env` exhibits the leak. Filed in `docs/handoffs/m9-handoff.md` for the user to issue post-merge.

  optional `repo_url` column (cross-cutting follow-up A).
```

```markdown
## What landed

### M9.2-T000 — Skill scaffold + script implementation

- `.claude/skills/save-log/SKILL.md` — full meeting-notes §2
  frontmatter (`disable-model-invocation: true`, `allowed-tools:
  Bash(python scripts/save_claude_session_log.py*)`,
  `argument-hint: "<name|id>"`, tags `logging`/`handoff`/`claude-code`)
  + a body documenting usage, output shape, safety rules, and
  out-of-scope follow-ups.
- `scripts/save_claude_session_log.py` — 16053 bytes, `chmod +x`.
  Implements selector matching (exact / prefix / substring scoring
  across `job_id` / `session_id` / `name`; ambiguous fuzzy matches
  raise), terminal-state gate (`TERMINAL_STATUSES = {completed,
  complete, stopped, stop}` with `done|success|succeeded` → `completed`
  and `cancelled|canceled` → `stopped` normalisation), transcript
  locator (state.json-embedded path → `<config_dir>/projects/**/<session_id>.jsonl`
  → `<config_dir>/projects/**/*<job_id>*.jsonl`), `uvx
  claude-code-log@latest --detail low --format md --compact` wrapper
  with seven attempt variants (`-o` / `--output` / stdout × `md` /
  `markdown`), nine-pattern secret-scan with the 10th generic
  `(password|passwd|secret|token)` assignment line, and atomic
  overwrite (`.tmp.md` → `replace`).
- `docs/logs/.gitkeep` — zero-byte placeholder.
- `.gitignore` carve-out — `!docs/logs/` + `!docs/logs/**` after the
  existing `**/logs/*` rule, so `docs/logs/` stays trackable while
  every other `logs/` path (e.g. `runs/<comp>/logs/`) stays ignored.
- Read-list discipline: the script reads only `~/.claude/projects/`,
  `~/.claude/jobs/`, and the stdout of `claude agents --json`. It does
  **not** read `.env*`, `~/.kaggle/kaggle.json`, `~/.ssh/**`,
  `~/.aws/**`, `~/.config/gcloud/**`, `~/.config/gh/**`, or
  `secrets/**` — stricter than the CLAUDE.md dev-phase carve-out, on
  purpose (no need for credentials).

### M9.2-T001 — Smoke + negative paths + README

- Positive smoke wrote `docs/logs/M9.md` (103 KB, 1284 lines, 0 ANSI,
  full header block, body opens with the `claude-code-log v1.3.0`
  generator marker). Transcript located via the state.json's
  embedded `~/.claude-ayla/projects/.../<session_id>.jsonl` path —
  this dev box uses `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=~/.claude-ayla` (set
  externally), and the locator picked it up via the first fallback
  (paths embedded in state.json) without ever needing the second
  (`<config_dir>/projects/**/<session_id>.jsonl`) or third fallback.
- Negative A (running session): selector `web-setup-exit` (status
  `working`) refused at exit 1.
- Negative B (ambiguous selector): selector `M` listed 10 candidates,
  refused at exit 1.
- Negative C (secret pattern): exercised via the task spec's
  authorised fallback (`scan_secret_like_text` direct test against
  10 known-positive + 1 known-negative samples, all PASS) plus an
  end-to-end gate test (`run_claude_code_log` patched to emit a fake
  `sk-ant-` string; gate raises without `--allow-secret-like`,
  succeeds with). Attempted the synthetic-`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` route
  first but `claude-code-log --detail low/high --compact` strips
  minimal-format JSONL message bodies before the scan, so the
  authorised fallback was used.
- README "Claude Code project skills" subsection added with the
  one-line `/save-log` description and a pointer to the SKILL.md.
- pytest 79 passed / 14 skipped — no regression.

- `docs/m9_2-final-review.md` (this file).

## Decision: docs/logs/M9.md (smoke evidence)

Per the M9.2-T001 task spec, the smoke export is evidence — the
reviewer decides per-export whether to commit it. **Decision: keep it
local; do not include in the M9.2 PR.** Rationale: the file is 103 KB
of M9's actual conversation transcript, which already has its own
artifact trail (`docs/m9-final-review.md`, `docs/handoffs/m9-handoff.md`).
Committing it would inflate the M9.2 PR with M9-belonging content and
set a precedent that smoke evidence lives in `docs/logs/` permanently.
The `/save-log` skill's value is producing the file on demand, not
pre-shipping any particular transcript. The header block in any future
manual export is self-contained evidence that the skill works.

The `.gitkeep` placeholder lands so the directory exists in the repo
the first time a future operator runs `/save-log`.

## What's NOT in M9.2 (by design)

- No new schema / migration / Supabase row.
- No CI coverage (the skill is operator-local; `uvx` is a dev
  dependency, not a CI dependency).
- No `claude logs` ANSI-strip fallback. The script fails loudly if the
  transcript JSONL can't be located (with the exact `find` hint).
- No `.claude/commands/save-log.md` mirror. Skills override commands
  of the same name.
- No model-invokable variant. `disable-model-invocation: true` is
  load-bearing.

## Risks / known limitations

- **Frontmatter compatibility.** `argument-hint`, `arguments`,
  `allowed-tools`, `disable-model-invocation`, `tags` are advisory in
  the current Claude Code loader version. The loader did not reject
  the file. If a future loader update tightens schema, the load-bearing
  pair remains `name:` + `description:`; the rest can be trimmed.
- **`uvx` availability.** The skill assumes `uvx` is on `PATH`. The
  Arch dev box has `uvx 0.11.14`; CI runners do not, but no CI job
  exercises the skill.
- **`~/.claude/projects/` layout drift.** Locator falls through three
  paths; if Claude Code reorganises the directory in a future release,
  the locator may miss. Documented in the script docstring.
- **Secret-pattern false positives.** Ten patterns are conservative.
  Any real false positive on a legitimate transcript is closed with
  `--allow-secret-like` after human inspection; the patterns are the
  safety net, not the policy.
- **`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` on this dev box.** Resolved to
  `~/.claude-ayla` (the harness home) at smoke-test time, not
  `~/.claude`. Either works because the script honours
  `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` and falls through to state.json-embedded paths.
  Other dev environments may need to set `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`
  explicitly.

## Follow-ups (optional, file as issues if pursued)

- `/save-log --all` — export every terminal-state project session in
  one shot.
- Supabase `agent_run_artifacts` promotion — would need a migration
  + the script reading the local DSN; out of scope here.
- `claude-code-log` Markdown post-processor — strip tool-call noise
  or redact file paths above an opt-in threshold.
- Tighten the locator to NOT also accept `~/.claude-ayla/` (currently
  it works because state.json carries the full path); revisit if the
  harness home convention changes.
```

```markdown
# Kaggle Code Agent — Project State

_Last updated: 2026-05-24 (M9 exit)_

## Product intent
Build a hybrid human + AI competition engineering workbench. The first target is Kaggle-style competitions, with future support for authorized CTF/lab challenges. The system should research, discuss ideas with humans, edit code, run tests/evaluations, analyze results, iterate, and prepare submissions under human-approved guardrails.

## Chosen architecture direction
- Hybrid architecture.
- Claude Code Desktop/CLI for interactive project development and dogfooding (primary development tool for all layers).
- Claude Agent SDK for the production coding worker.
- Python-first worker for Kaggle/ML/CTF execution.
- TypeScript/Supabase control plane and UI shell (developed in Claude Code, not Lovable).
- GitHub + Claude Code + CI + Supabase migrations are the source of truth. All decisions, architecture, task specs, and safety rules live in repo files.
- Supabase is the control plane and audit database, not the primary code execution environment.

## Current MVP boundary
1. Local-first repository workflow with `CLAUDE.md`, skills, hooks, subagents, and GitHub.
2. Supabase schema for projects, sessions, jobs, messages, research notes, experiments, runs, submissions, artifacts, approvals, and `agent_tool_audit` (M8).
3. Kaggle baseline loop: understand competition, create validation, run baseline, record metrics, iterate, prepare submission.
4. Browser/research loop: fetch pages, summarize sources, track trust and citations.
5. Multi-agent reviewer gate + OTEL telemetry + local GPU model layer.
6. Authorized CTF sandbox loop only for explicit challenge environments.
7. Operator-facing UI: Dashboard, Run Timeline (OTEL swim-lane), Experiments, Research, Approval Inbox + Decision Gate, Artifact Browser.

## Human approval gates
Require approval for:
- Kaggle competition submissions.
- Kaggle kernel/notebook pushes.
- Any remote write operation.
- Any operation touching credentials, secrets, or account settings.
- Any CTF action outside a declared sandbox/challenge scope.
- PR merges (create is allowed, merge requires approval).

Mutations from the UI flow through `services/decision_api/` (FastAPI) →
`tools/kca/decisions.py` → DB. The browser bundle never holds a
Supabase service-role key. The M7 permission policy resolution stays
authoritative.

## Completed milestones
- **M0**: project baseline and memory discipline ✓
- **M1**: local Kaggle tooling wrapper baseline ✓
- **M2**: Supabase/control plane foundation ✓
- **M3**: Python-first competition worker v0 ✓
- **M4**: Kaggle competition workflow v0 ✓
- **M5**: research and browser workflow ✓
- **M6**: multi-agent review + OTEL telemetry + local-model layer ✓
- **M7**: KCA CLI architecture (command / skill / tool / permission policy) ✓
- **M8**: product UI shell + M7 follow-ups (audit table, schema gate, ToolSpec enforcement, decision_api) ✓
- **M8.5**: pre-M9 hardening — CI repair + GitHub Issues/PR/labels interface + M9 planning ✓
- **M9**: live end-to-end Kaggle regression test — Spaceship Titanic ✓

See `docs/m8-final-review.md` for M8 validation results (all 28 non-SKIP
checks PASS), `docs/m8_5-final-review.md` for the M8.5 roll-up (all 26
non-SKIP checks PASS; three PRs landed on `main` as #4, #5, #6), and
`docs/m9-final-review.md` for the M9 roll-up (30 PASS / 1 SKIP / 0 FAIL;
the SKIP is UI pnpm gates — M9 did not modify UI).
```

````
# save-log — export Claude Code session transcript to logs/

Use this skill to turn a **stopped** or **completed** Claude Code
background-session transcript into a clean Markdown file under
`logs/<session-name>.md`, ready for handoff packs or milestone
evidence.

## Usage

```text
/save-log <name|id>
```

Examples:

```text
/save-log M7
/save-log 01F8ABC
/save-log 01F8ABCDEF1234567890
```

Prefer a Claude Code **agent name** or **short job id** for the selector.
If the agent name has spaces, use an id; or rename the agent to a
slug-like string (`M7`, `m9-2-impl`, …) first.

---
445:        default="low",
450:        "--output-dir",
451:        default="logs",
452:        help="output directory, relative to repo root",
479:    output_dir = (root / args.output_dir).resolve()
480:    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
485:    output_path = output_dir / f"{out_name}.md"
````
